evaluation.o_fit: O optimizes decision-changing real-world progress, so evaluator validity should be measured by downstream predictive behavior, not leaderboard discrimination.

cross_field.uncertainty: Requires predictive task features and out-of-sample routing validation; feature cost matters.

cross_field.o_fit: Could improve parallel research utilization, but O external clean workers intentionally preserve independent fixed biases and may not safely share frontiers.
cross_field.scope: Fully strict Cilk computations with coarse ready tasks and high parallelism.
